chips.noTraining: We don't train AI on your sessions

brandStatement.body: Superwizor AI helps mental health professionals reclaim their mental space for attentive sessions, supporting process continuity and a deeper understanding of the client.

problem.overline: The cost unseen in the calendar
problem.title: Most of the session is lost not during — but after.
problem.body: A theme you wanted to return to. A sentence that seemed important. A direction you agreed upon. You keep all this in your head until the next meeting — and with a full schedule, the head cannot carry every detail. It's not a matter of discipline, but the number of sessions.
problem.quote: Prevents losing 30-40% of the information that I lose when preparing notes manually.

differentiator.quote: It's not about time — the app takes away the burden of thinking about the client.

rodo.q: How does GDPR and patient data security work?
rodo.a: All personal and medical data is fully protected. Data is hosted in EU data centers (GCP Frankfurt/Warsaw). Data transmission is encrypted via SSL, and audio files are automatically purged from the servers immediately after transcription. Confidential database columns are additionally encrypted using envelope encryption.

dpa.q: Do I need to sign a Data Processing Agreement (DPA)?
dpa.a: Yes. In accordance with GDPR (Article 28), every therapist using Superwizor AI must sign a Data Processing Agreement (DPA). We provide a ready-to-sign, fully compliant template that you can sign electronically in one click directly inside the application's admin panel.

consent.q: How do I get client consent for recording and AI analysis?
consent.a: Recording sessions requires the patient's explicit, informed consent. In the legal resources section of the app, you will find ready-to-download and printable templates for patient consent forms covering session recording and AI-assisted analysis, prepared by medical data protection lawyers.

training.q: Does the AI learn from my recordings or transcripts?
training.a: Absolutely not. We run Vertex AI models within Google Cloud, which guarantees that none of your inputs (audio, transcripts, generated notes) are used for training, fine-tuning, or improving Google's or any third-party's AI models.

modality.q: For which psychotherapeutic modalities is Superwizor AI designed?
modality.a: The application is built for leading psychotherapy approaches, offering dedicated templates tailored specifically to your work. We fully support: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Psychodynamic, Humanistic-Experiential (including Gestalt), Systemic, Integrative, and Solution-Focused Brief Therapy (SFBT/TSR). The system automatically adjusts the report structure and clinical terms to the core assumptions of your chosen modality.

vat.q: Will I receive a VAT invoice for my subscription?
vat.a: Yes. After each purchase or automatic subscription renewal, our billing system automatically generates and sends a full VAT invoice (including NIP/tax ID and company name) to your email address, ready for business expense accounting in Poland/EU.
